title: Rosalind and the Promise
author: Elodie Oyelaran
blurb: Sebastian Joubert, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
